note: The Sunweaver's staff, tier I (plain): a pale ash shaft with an iron foot and two gilt rings, a leather grip, a steel collar and a small gilt sun (a gilt square over a cream turned square, the eight-pointed star) holding the lit heart; 40.3 px; the heart (12 lit texels, the south face of its cube) is the same cube at the same sheet spot in all three tiers, so one sun_staff_e.png lights them all.
